summary: Export daemon resident memory, glibc heap allocation and fragmentation states, and checkpoint allocator reclamation totals through opt-in OpenTelemetry metrics.

replay.detail: Telemetry only; existing claims are not replayed.

schema.detail: No database schema or persisted claim format changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: No required client, protocol or harness compatibility changes; glibc heap metrics require Linux GNU with glibc 2.33 or newer.

downtime.detail: No new service interruption requirements beyond the normal binary upgrade.

manual.detail: No new required manual steps; telemetry export remains opt-in.

recovery.detail: Telemetry-only changes add no new rollback or roll-forward requirements.
